title: Find the Winner of the Circular Game
summary: In a circle of n friends numbered from 1 to n, starting from the 1st friend, count k friends in the clockwise direction, including the starting friend.
statement: In a circle of n friends numbered from 1 to n, starting from the 1st friend, count k friends in the clockwise direction, including the starting friend. The friend you count to leaves the circle. Repeat the process starting from the friend immediately clockwise of the one who just left until only one friend remains, who is the winner of the game.
constraints: Friends are labeled one through n and counting starts at friend one.
Remove every kth remaining friend clockwise until one winner remains.
hints: After one removal, the remaining game is the same problem with one fewer friend but rotated labels.
Let solve(size) return a zero-based winner; unwind with (previous+k) modulo size.
Use base case solve(1)=0, then convert the final result to one-based.
The recurrence exactly reverses the relabeling performed after each kth removal, so induction over circle size identifies the survivor.
editorial: The recurrence exactly reverses the relabeling performed after each kth removal, so induction over circle size identifies the survivor.

tests.explanation: Following the circular eliminations leaves friend one.
